method: Genuine reference executable via public controller/image JSON. Exact opaque supplied platform art and Mario sprite matching, checked visually. Actual native-frame counts accumulated after reset. No ROM, executable internals or game state read.
coordinateConvention: Image y is down. Observed Mario opaque feet are one pixel above platform artwork top when standing. Width48 is the complete supplied assembly; 32/24px nested fragments are not extra objects.

cases.worldXStatus: Inferred from independently registered source campaign and static geometry; ±2px registration uncertainty.

simpleSineDiagnostic.fit: Least squares offset + A*cos(2πf/384) + B*sin(2πf/384), 132 unmounted full-width samples.

rules: Mounted Mario follows vertical displacement exactly; observed feet=artworkTop−1 at all69 standing checkpoints.
Mounting and jumping off do not change its phase; same-native-frame idle and mounted observations match exactly.
Short jump leaves the moving surface and returns to it through normal falling collision.
unresolved: Exact acceleration schedule, initial load/activation phase and native fixed-point rounding are unresolved. The measured curve has a slow top section and is not established as a sine.
Bounds are actual visible extrema. Collision surface y=artworkTop−1 is inferred from opaque feet, not engine memory.

rules: No pulley rope is attached. The previous automatic balance classification was incorrect.

rules: When Mario stands on the right partner, it descends while the left partner rises.

limitations: This calibrates four observed mechanisms, not every campaign platform or activation phase.
A player template detector can select enemy-colored candidates; critical standing/ride observations were inspected visually and checked for geometric continuity.
All reference screenshots and traces remain ignored local evidence. No reference image is runtime game content.
